Page 248
Dec. 1 Mrs. John F. Degelbeck - Elderly - presbiterian - - fearful head- aches for years; went to a big hospital (Ann Arbor) had operation and now worse than ever. Enrolled To-night at 7:50 P.M.
2 Mrs. P. Frigeris - 38 - broken needle lodged in threatening place in finger - promised to go more frequently if relief from pain and danger .....
Mrs. Mary Stimpson of Saginaw - 63 - full of cancers - operation seems futle - to have been for naught ..... Enrolled again - 50c in Ser. Mass Ass'n
4 Mrs. Marie Hilberg - T. B. at home
Bonnell ... about
Mrs. F1. Bergin - 42 - cancer of womb - living on ice and narcotics Thanks .... Mrs. Ach. Murray - 50 - Nerv. Brk. down - Jewish husband - 19 shots. another would have killed her .... O.K !....
Page 249 Dec. 5 Neil Fraley - St. Clair, mich. - 35 - liver, heart, etc. Some Drs. think it enemia; has family of nine depending on him. ...
June Arnet - 18 - Eye - struck by snow-ball last winter -- going to Marygrove
Mrs. Ella Hammell of Howell, Mich. - 71 - almost blind - glucoma ..... Geo Dederich -68 - dizbetis - gangreenous foot removed .... Enrolled To- day perpt ....
Dorothy Klanow - 25 now - 5 yrs ago in accident ... broken back ... Drs. all expected her to die ... Her sister came weeping and Enrolled her in Ser. Masses and after two months was Okay - Drs. astonished.
Mrs. Clara Castoban - 36 - cancer of womb - given up by all Drs.
Betty Ann Cooper - 12 - "Athletic foot.
Charles Christoff - 26 - threatening stomach trouble ...
